THE PROBLEM

But reporting it means writing in Korean.

FATALITIES, 2025

286

Construction workers died in investigated workplace accidents in 2025, per Korea's Labor Ministry.

KOREA'S 2027 BUDGET PROPOSAL

₩5.8B

Proposed (~US$4.1M) for industrial-safety AI and worker-reporting technology.

3 DAYS AGO

Incheon's labor office acted Sept 22 under Korea's amended OSH Act, which expands multilingual safety materials, mandates training for every new foreign hire, and requires site-wide electronic attendance tracking.

UNDER KOREAN LAW

Executives can face personal criminal liability

not just the company — for safety failures that go unaddressed.

A worker spots frayed wiring by a puddle. No Korean word comes to mind. He says nothing.

Midday, open rooftop, no shade. There's no easy way to flag it either.
